title: pricing-packaging-scratchpad-maya-2026-03-04
content:
BACK OF THE ENVELOPE NOTES - PRICING / PACKAGING (Maya)

Context / goal:
- Need quick tiers for hosted API that reflect both cost and go-to-market simplicity.
- Primary signal: tokens consumed (gen + context). Secondary: concurrent throughput / reserved capacity for dedicated.
- Want guardrails for promoting Dedicated / Private upsell when usage hits economics threshold.

Assumptions (very rough):
- GPU inference cost (amortized + infra) for common open LLM family: $6–$12 / 1M output tokens (depends on quant, batching, model size). Pick baseline $8 / 1M tokens for mid-size models (e.g., 13B quant).
- Hosting + overhead (control plane, storage, telemetry): add $1.5 / 1M tokens.
- Customer acquisition + support + margin target: aim for 4x markup on unit cost for self-serve; lower for committed contracts.
- Typical prompt/completion mix: 30% prompt (context) / 70% completion tokens by cost because generation dominates. But charge model counts both directions; we need to model both.

Token math quick model:
- cost_per_1M_tokens_raw = $8 (inference) + $1.5 (infra) = $9.5
- target_price_self_serve = 4x => $38 / 1M tokens (rounded $0.000038 / token)
- target_price_volume_discount (committed mid) = 2x => $19 / 1M tokens
- enterprise/dedicated pricing = custom + include reserved GPU margins and infra SLA. Effective unit price target $8–$12 / 1M for big commitments.

Example customer usage scenarios:
1) Chat assistant (few-shot context): 200 tokens prompt + 1200 tokens completion = 1400 tokens per request.
   - At $38 / 1M: cost = 1400 * $0.000038 = $0.0532 / conversation.
   - If 100k conv/mo => $5,320 / mo.
2) Embeddings-heavy search (1M embeddings of 512 tokens each is unrealistic). For embeddings we likely price per vector or per 1k vectors. Need separate price.

Pricing tier ideas (self-serve hosted):
- Free tier: 0–50k tokens / mo, credit runway, limits on rate.
- Developer: $20 / mo credit -> e.g., $20 covers ~526k tokens at $38 / 1M (good for trial).
- Growth: $200 / mo credit (covers 5.26M tokens) + overage rates at $30 / 1M.
- Business: $1k / mo credit + seat/pro support + up to 30M tokens, overage $20 / 1M.
Notes: credits as subscription is simplest for PLG. Overages trigger billing via per-token.

Dedicated / Private triggers:
- Recommend sales outreach when monthly token spending > $40k or sustained sustained qps > X (work out) or strict data residency needs.
- Threshold justification: at $19 / 1M committed price, 40k spend -> ~2.1B tokens/mo? Wait check: $19/1M => $0.000019 / token; $40k / 0.000019 = ~2.1B tokens. That's too high. Re-evaluate thresholds: use spend threshold $10k/month as practical.

Sensitivity / knobs:
- Model mix: 70% traffic on 13B quant, 30% on larger 70B -> blended cost goes up. Need per-model unit cost catalog.
- Batching & cache: effective inference cost can drop 20–35% for high qps workloads.
- Quality/regression risk: cheaper quant/profile can increase hallucinations -> price/offer must pair with evaluation/QA tools.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Decide separate pricing for embeddings: per 1k vectors vs per token? Industry tends to price per 1k vectors. Quick suggestion: $0.10 per 1k 1536-d embeddings (baseline) then scale by model dim.
- Finalize overage pricing math and decimals for UX.
- Add per-route throttles and price breaks for sync vs streaming (streaming is more CPU + network but similar token cost).
- Map out triggers and playbook for converting high-usage tenants to Dedicated / Private (ops checklist + SRE cost adders).
- Create model-level cost table (for docs): model name, quant state, inference $/1M tokens, recommended retail $/1M tokens.

Quick back-of-envelope to build model-level table (example rows):
- model: redwood-13b-quant -> infra cost $6 / 1M -> infra+overhead $7.5 -> self-serve price $30 / 1M
- model: redwood-70b-quant -> infra cost $12 / 1M -> infra+overhead $13.5 -> self-serve price $54 / 1M

UX notes:
- Pricing page must show examples ("X messages per month ~= $Y") and clear counts for prompt+completion tokens.
- Provide a cost estimator widget in Console for customers to simulate monthly spend given messages/day and avg tokens.

Slack snippets / links to paste:
- "We should use 4x markup on per-model unit cost for public self-serve pricing, with aggressive 2x for committed agreements; threshold for Dedicated is $10k/mo or when customer needs isolation."

Versioning / tracking:
- Save this as draft. Need to sync with finance to validate infra cost assumptions.
- Follow-up: build spreadsheet that parameterizes GPU amortization, batching % and model mix to output recommended price bands and thresholds.

---
Notes to self: messy, lots of handwavy numbers. Build spreadsheet next and ask SRE + infra for real $/1M per model.
summary: Personal scratchpad for pricing/packaging token math. Contains assumptions, tier sketches, unit economics, and open action items.
